description: Environment setup - install all dependencies, verify existing tests pass, verify pnpm build works, establish baseline for Phase 5 development.
steps: Run `uv sync` in apps/api/ to install Python dependencies
Run `pnpm install` in apps/web/ to install Node.js dependencies
Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` in apps/api/ and confirm all 127 tests pass
Run `uv run ruff check .` in apps/api/ and confirm no lint errors
Run `pnpm build` in apps/web/ and confirm build succeeds
verification: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/ -v
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
findings: All 127 tests pass (3.78s). 20 RuntimeWarnings about unawaited coroutines in mocks (pre-existing, non-blocking). Ruff check clean. pnpm build succeeds (11 pages generated). Dependencies already installed from prior phases - uv sync and pnpm install were no-ops.
